description: This file implements the StateHandler class for managing lifecycle states within a plugin framework. It includes methods for updating states, creating state instances, validating state transitions, initializing transition mappings, changing states with event notifications, and retrieving state paths. The code interacts with application context, lifecycle states, and event handling components.

classes.name: StateHandler
classes.description: A class responsible for managing lifecycle state transitions, creation, validation, and event notification within the plugin framework.

methods.name: updateState
methods.description: Updates the application state to the specified lifecycle state, handling state creation, transition, and cleanup.

methods.name: createState
methods.description: Creates a new state object based on the specified lifecycle state.

methods.name: isValidTransition
methods.description: Checks if a transition from start to target state is valid, considering the current transition path.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the possible state transitions and state string mappings.

methods.name: changeState
methods.description: Performs a state change request, managing the transition sequence, event notifications, and pending states.

methods.name: sendEvent
methods.description: Sends a state change event with details about the old and new lifecycle states.

methods.name: getStatePath
methods.description: Retrieves the sequence of states required to reach the target state from the current state.
